worldcombat.skill.razorshell.summary: Flash the shell edge and sweep a wide arc in front: every foe in the fan takes a carving cut and each has a chance to lose a Defence stage; the watery edge also soaks whoever it cuts. The Full-Moon style sweeps wider and shaves more often; the Keen-Edge style narrows to one blade and hits harder per target.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.description: Every target inside the arc takes a %1$s contact cut.
Centred on the user it sweeps a %1$s block fan opening %2$s degrees.
A landed cut has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Defence by %2$s stage and leaves it wet for %3$s; it also pushes each target outward along the arc.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.wide.on: Full-Moon style: a wider fan, a higher shave chance, a longer soak and a stronger push, at the cost of ×0.88 per hit and +6 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.wide.off: Keen-Edge style: a narrower fan, but ×1.15 per hit, a shorter cooldown and a slightly lower shave chance - better against a single target.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.growth.0: From level %1$s the carve rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.growth.1: From level %1$s the carve rises to %2$s and the shave chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.use.0: Carve several targets at once with a wide front arc
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.use.1: Shave the Defence off a whole rank of foes
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.use.2: Soak everyone it cuts, leaving a wet window for other moves
